name: Magic Eden

requiredConfig.name: MAGICEDEN_API_KEY
requiredConfig.description: Magic Eden REST API key (sent as Authorization: Bearer). Required for live reads and prepared actions. Must never be persisted in receipts, prepared-action params, or browser state.

requiredConfig.name: MAGICEDEN_CONNECTOR_ENABLED
requiredConfig.description: Feature flag (true/false). Must be true to enable the connector. Guards against the 2026-02-27 Magic Eden API infrastructure transition.

requiredConfig.name: MAGICEDEN_API_BASE_URL
requiredConfig.description: Override the Magic Eden Solana API base URL. Defaults to https://api-mainnet.magiceden.dev/v2.

readCapabilities.returns: API and trading endpoint health with rate-limit information and the active API-transition warning.
Magic Eden collection metadata, floor, listed count, royalty, top bid, and optional listing/bid rows.
Active Magic Eden listings (price, seller, listing id, auction house) for a Solana collection.
Active Magic Eden bids for a Solana collection (price, buyer, bid id, expiry when available).
Recent Magic Eden Solana activity rows (list, delist, buy_now, bid, accept_bid, transfer, mint).
Wallet-owned Magic Eden Solana NFTs with listed-vs-held breakdown.
Magic Eden NFT detail by mint: ownership, listing, top bid, last sale, royalty.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction capturing mint, listing id, expected seller, current price, maxPriceSol cap, fee/royalty preview, and API health snapshot. Refreshes listing state at execution.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Magic Eden buy transaction generated by the Magic Eden trading endpoint at execution time after the listing has been re-checked for drift.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that lists a wallet-owned mint at priceSol with optional expiry. Refuses when the wallet does not own the mint per Magic Eden.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Magic Eden list transaction generated by the Magic Eden API at execution time.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that cancels the wallet's active listing for the given mint.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Magic Eden cancel listing transaction generated by the Magic Eden API at execution time.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that places an item or collection bid, capped by maxEscrowSol. Refuses when required escrow exceeds the cap.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Magic Eden bid transaction generated by the Magic Eden API at execution time.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that cancels a Magic Eden bid by bid id, mint, or collection.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Magic Eden cancel bid transaction generated by the Magic Eden API at execution time.

requiredUserInputs.name: mintAddress
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which NFT mint should Magic Eden use?

requiredUserInputs.name: maxPriceSol
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What is the maximum price (in SOL) you will pay for this NFT?

requiredUserInputs.name: priceSol
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What is the list price (in SOL)?

requiredUserInputs.name: bidPriceSol
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What bid price (in SOL) should I propose?

requiredUserInputs.name: maxEscrowSol
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What is the maximum SOL you allow Magic Eden to lock in escrow for this bid?

requiredUserInputs.name: collectionSymbol
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Magic Eden collection symbol should I use?

requiredConnectorFacts: API health snapshot (trading endpoints operational) before any write prepare
Active listing row (price, seller, listing id) before buy prepare or execute
Wallet ownership of the mint before list prepare or execute
Required escrow lamports versus maxEscrowSol cap before bid prepare
Verified collection flag and royalty basis points where the API exposes them
unsupportedRequests: Promise guaranteed sales, floors, or speculative returns.
Buy, list, bid, or cancel on devnet/testnet.
Trade Bitcoin, Runes, or EVM NFTs through this connector.
Move funds without wallet approval or with autonomous signing.
Use Magic Eden when MAGICEDEN_API_KEY is missing or MAGICEDEN_CONNECTOR_ENABLED is not true.
Override royalties, marketplace fees, or auction-house policy.
actionPreparationNotes: Snapshot Magic Eden API health and the active listing/bid before storing a PreparedAction. Do not persist the API key in params, receipts, or warnings. Execution must refresh listing/bid state and refuse on any drift (price, seller, listing id, ownership). Bitcoin/EVM/Runes inputs are rejected at the input layer.
riskNotes: Surface Magic Eden's 2026-02-27 API infrastructure notice on every prepared action. Warn when royalty or fee data is missing. Warn when the trading endpoint is degraded. Never describe NFT trades as guaranteed or risk-free.
walletApprovalBoundary: Magic Eden writes are prepare-only. The Magic Eden API generates the transaction; the wallet signs and broadcasts. The agent never signs.

requests.agentResponse: Returned Magic Eden API and trading endpoint health with the active API-transition warning.

requests.user: show Magic Eden listings for okay_bears
requests.agentResponse: Returned active Magic Eden listings for the okay_bears collection.

requests.user: show my Magic Eden listed NFTs
requests.agentResponse: Returned the connected wallet's Magic Eden NFTs with listed-vs-held breakdown.

requests.user: prepare buying this NFT on Magic Eden for no more than 1 SOL, do not sign
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Magic Eden buy with maxPriceSol=1. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: prepare listing this NFT on Magic Eden for 1.5 SOL
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Magic Eden listing at 1.5 SOL. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: prepare canceling my Magic Eden listing for this mint
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Magic Eden cancel listing for the connected wallet. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: guarantee my NFT will sell on Magic Eden
requests.agentResponse: Magic Eden listings have no guaranteed sale. The agent will not promise speculative outcomes.

requests.user: buy this Bitcoin Rune on Magic Eden
requests.agentResponse: This connector covers Solana NFTs only. Bitcoin and Runes are out of scope.

requests.user: list my NFT on Magic Eden devnet
requests.agentResponse: Magic Eden connector actions are mainnet-beta only.
